title: Crisp Slovakian Broccoli Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy Chinese-inspired stir fry that combines the fresh flavors of broccoli and curry with the earthy sweetness of Slovakian ingredients.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and sliced ginger and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the broccoli and curry powder, and stir to combine.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the broccoli starts to soften.
Increase heat to high and stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes, until the broccoli is crisp-tender.
Season with salt and serve immediately.
